toolchain.note: Every transcript in this laboratory was produced by the installed Icarus Verilog 13.0 toolchain in Verilog-2001 mode.

experiment-01.summary: Build AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR and XNOR from continuous assignments, then compare every output against an independent truth table for all four input combinations.

experiment-02.summary: Derive half and full adders from their Boolean equations, implement both in Verilog-2001, and verify all four half-adder and all eight full-adder input combinations.

experiment-03.summary: Implement half and full subtractors with borrow logic, then verify every input combination against independent difference and borrow expectations.

experiment-04.summary: Connect four full-adder instances into a four-bit ripple-carry adder, expose carry-out and signed overflow, and sweep all 512 input combinations.

experiment-05.summary: Implement 2:1, 4:1 and 8:1 multiplexers, then verify every select value and every data pattern for each width: 2,132 checks in total.

experiment-06.summary: Implement 1:2, 1:4 and 1:8 demultiplexers so exactly one output follows the data input, then verify every select and data combination.
